bingo.label: Bingo
bingo.description: Server bingo: 5×5 cards, draws, line or full-card detection.
bingo.noGame: ❌ No game in progress. Staff can start one with `/bingo start`.
bingo.startedBody: Mode: **{mode}**. Grab your card with `/bingo join`, then staff draws numbers with `/bingo draw`.
bingo.noCard: ❌ You have no card. Join with `/bingo join`.
bingo.allDrawn: All numbers have already been drawn!

defaultMode.label: Default winning mode
defaultMode.help: The win condition offered when a game is started without naming a mode: one full line, or the whole card. Whoever starts the game can still pick the other.
